payload.title: Half time: Fallowmere Albion 1-1 Elmstead United
payload.story: At half time Fallowmere Albion and Elmstead United are level 1-1. Fallowmere have outshot Elmstead 14 to 5 and led the expected goals 2.23 to 0.54 but they have only three shots on target to Elmstead's two. Fallowmere have completed 156 of 191 passes while Elmstead have completed 140 of 199 and turnovers in the last window hit 27. Kenji Halez has been central scoring once and carrying an xG of 1.46 while Tariq Garo has added 0.49 xG of his own and Tendai Calova has supplied three key passes. Control has swung with Fallowmere enjoying the attacking momentum but the scoreline remains level going into the break.
key_moments: Sipho Lunwell opened the scoring for Elmstead United.
Fallowmere dominated chances and territory without converting early pressure.
Kenji Halez levelled for Fallowmere Albion.
Turnovers spiked late in the half and gave Fallowmere momentum.

translations.es: Al descanso Fallowmere Albion y Elmstead United están empatados 1-1. Fallowmere ha superado a Elmstead en disparos 14 a 5 y ha liderado los goles esperados 2.23 a 0.54 pero solo ha tenido tres disparos a puerta frente a los dos de Elmstead. Fallowmere ha completado 156 de 191 pases mientras Elmstead ha completado 140 de 199 y las pérdidas de posesión en la última ventana llegaron a 27. Kenji Halez ha sido clave marcando una vez y registrando un xG de 1.46 mientras Tariq Garo ha sumado 0.49 xG propio y Tendai Calova ha dado tres pases clave. El control ha cambiado con Fallowmere disfrutando del impulso ofensivo pero el marcador sigue igualado al descanso.
translations.fr: À la mi temps, Fallowmere Albion et Elmstead United sont à égalité 1-1. Fallowmere a tenté sa chance 14 fois contre 5 pour Elmstead et mène sur les expected goals 2.23 à 0.54, mais n’a cadré que trois tirs contre deux pour Elmstead. Fallowmere a réussi 156 de ses 191 passes tandis qu’Elmstead en a réussi 140 sur 199 et les turnovers dans la dernière période ont atteint 27. Kenji Halez a été au coeur du jeu en marquant une fois et en portant un xG de 1.46, tandis que Tariq Garo a ajouté 0.49 xG de son côté et Tendai Calova a délivré trois passes clés. Le contrôle a changé de camp avec Fallowmere qui profite de l’élan offensif mais le score reste à égalité à la pause.
translations.pt: Ao intervalo, Fallowmere Albion e Elmstead United estão empatados 1-1. Fallowmere rematou mais do que Elmstead, 14 contra 5, e lidera nos expected goals 2.23 a 0.54, mas tem apenas três remates à baliza contra dois de Elmstead. Fallowmere completou 156 dos seus 191 passes enquanto Elmstead completou 140 de 199 e as perdas de posse na última janela chegaram a 27. Kenji Halez esteve no centro da ação ao marcar uma vez e apresentar um xG de 1.46, enquanto Tariq Garo acrescentou 0.49 xG próprio e Tendai Calova forneceu três passes para golo. O controlo tem mudado de lado, com Fallowmere a beneficiar do ímpeto ofensivo, mas o resultado mantém se empatado ao intervalo.

payload.headline: Late away pressure holds
payload.why: Elmstead United stay composed in a balanced finish, with a high cross into the final right turning a tense last phase into control of territory. The pass mattered because the match had 12 turnovers in the last 5 minutes, so a clean 38.2 metre completion at 50.8 km/h cut through the chaos and kept Elmstead United ahead at 2 to 3.

translations.fr: 49 indice de contrôle. Elmstead United est resté équilibré, puis Lewin Weswu a complété un centre haut de 38.2 metre à 50.8 km/h vers le final right, aidant à échapper à 12 turnovers.
translations.pt: 49 índice de controlo. Elmstead United manteve-se equilibrado, depois Lewin Weswu completou um cruzamento alto de 38.2 metre a 50.8 km/h para o final right, ajudando a escapar de 12 turnovers.

In a match with an index of 49, 12 turnovers in the last 5 minutes and only 4.2 passes per minute, one clean wide delivery cut through the chaos and decided the game state.

payload.title: Fallowmere Albion 3-3 Elmstead United
payload.story: Fallowmere Albion fought back to draw 3-3 with Elmstead United. Sipho Lunwell put Elmstead ahead before Kenji Halez scored twice to turn the game for Fallowmere and Tariq Garo grabbed a late equaliser. Lunwell finished with three goals while Halez ended with 2 goals for Fallowmere. Fallowmere piled up the better expected goals with 3.38 xG and 31 shots while Elmstead managed 1.24 xG from 17 attempts. Elmstead made 357 passes to Fallowmere's 352 but Fallowmere had 11 shots on target to Elmstead's 7 and the finish was chaotic with an index of 12.6 and 17 turnovers late on.
key_moments: Sipho Lunwell opens the scoring for Elmstead
Kenji Halez scores twice to put Fallowmere ahead
Sipho Lunwell's late goals restore Elmstead's lead
Tariq Garo's stoppage-time strike earns a draw

translations.es: Fallowmere Albion reaccionó para empatar 3-3 con Elmstead United. Sipho Lunwell adelantó a Elmstead antes de que Kenji Halez marcara dos veces para voltear el partido para Fallowmere y Tariq Garo lograra un empate tardío. Lunwell terminó con tres goles mientras Halez acabó con 2 goles para Fallowmere. Fallowmere acumuló mejores goles esperados con 3.38 xG y 31 disparos mientras Elmstead logró 1.24 xG de 17 intentos. Elmstead dio 357 pases frente a los 352 de Fallowmere pero Fallowmere tuvo 11 disparos a puerta contra 7 de Elmstead y la definición fue caótica con un índice de 12.6 y 17 pérdidas de balón al final.
translations.fr: Fallowmere Albion est revenu pour faire match nul 3-3 avec Elmstead United. Sipho Lunwell a mis Elmstead devant avant que Kenji Halez ne marque deux fois pour renverser le match pour Fallowmere et Tariq Garo a arraché l'égalisation en fin de rencontre. Lunwell a terminé avec trois buts tandis que Halez a conclu avec 2 buts pour Fallowmere. Fallowmere a cumulé les meilleures expected goals avec 3.38 xG et 31 tirs tandis qu'Elmstead a obtenu 1.24 xG en 17 tentatives. Elmstead a réussi 357 passes contre 352 pour Fallowmere mais Fallowmere a cadré 11 tirs contre 7 pour Elmstead et la fin a été chaotique avec un indice de 12.6 et 17 turnovers en fin de match.
translations.pt: O Fallowmere Albion reagiu para empatar 3-3 com o Elmstead United. Sipho Lunwell colocou o Elmstead na frente antes de Kenji Halez marcar duas vezes para virar o jogo para o Fallowmere e Tariq Garo arrancar um empate tardio. Lunwell terminou com três gols enquanto Halez fechou com 2 gols para o Fallowmere. O Fallowmere somou os melhores expected goals com 3.38 xG e 31 chutes, enquanto o Elmstead conseguiu 1.24 xG em 17 tentativas. O Elmstead fez 357 passes contra 352 do Fallowmere, mas o Fallowmere teve 11 chutes no alvo contra 7 do Elmstead e o fim foi caótico com um índice de 12.6 e 17 turnovers no fim.
